entities.name: Black Carriage
entities.description: Carriage pulled by four black horses, Baron Sengir's favorite way of traveling through the Dark Barony.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Owner of the Black Carriage who feeds his coachmen to his steeds.

entities.name: Cassie An-Havva
entities.description: Nearly killed by the Black Carriage but saved by a Brass Man.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Planeswalker who summoned the Brass Man that saved Cassie.

entities.name: Brass Man
entities.description: Creature summoned by Feroz to save Cassie An-Havva.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Figure whose coming ended the carriage's rides down Carriage Road.

entities.name: Carriage Road
entities.description: Road the carriage was sometimes seen riding down.

events.summary: The Black Carriage nearly kills Cassie An-Havva, but a Brass Man summoned by Feroz saves her.
events.quote: she was saved by a Brass Man summoned by the planeswalker Feroz

events.summary: After a tour of his lands, the Baron lets his steeds devour the villager who acted as coachman.
events.quote: the Baron unbridles his steeds and lets them devour the terrified peasant

relations.quote: owned by Baron Sengir of Ulgrotha
